core_data.visual_description: Robed in fractal gold, eyes glowing with solar glyphs, surrounded by floating mantra sigils
core_data.voice_tone: Calm, measured, with weight of ages

abilities.name: Solar Invocation
abilities.effect: Purifies corruption in 3-tile radius, grants Light resonance buff (+30% Light skill damage)

abilities.name: Bloomfield Barrier
abilities.effect: Creates protective barrier that absorbs 50 damage, reflects 20% back as Light damage

abilities.name: Mantra of Renewal
abilities.effect: Restores 40 HP to all allies, removes 1 debuff

base_greetings.first_meeting: The sun's warmth reaches even the darkest corners. I am Suryanatha, keeper of the old ways. What brings you to our sanctuary?
base_greetings.friendly: Ah, my friend. The light remembers your presence. Walk with me.
base_greetings.neutral: Seeker. The Ashram watches, as always.
base_greetings.hostile: You tread upon sacred ground with tainted steps. State your purpose or leave.
base_greetings.loop_aware: We have met before, in echoes and endings. This time, perhaps, will be different.

Light.low_usage: You wield the Light well. Few remember its true nature.
Light.medium_usage: The solar glyphs recognize you. You are becoming one with the radiance.
Light.high_usage: You are a vessel of pure Light. Even the Oracle would be moved.
Light.mastery: I see the sun's memory within you. You have transcended mere technique.

Shadow.low_usage: Shadow has its place, but tread carefully. Balance is sacred.
Shadow.medium_usage: The darkness grows in you. Remember: shadow without light is blindness.
Shadow.high_usage: You walk a dangerous path. The Ashram watches with concern.
Shadow.corruption: You reek of corruption. Unless you seek purification, you are not welcome here.

Void.any_usage: Void energy... The absence that unmakes. Why do you court oblivion?
Void.repeated: Your persistence with the Void troubles me. Rajas walks this path, and look what he has become.
Void.mastery: You have mastered what should not be mastered. I cannot condone this, but... I cannot deny its power.

Bloom.any_usage: Ah, growth and renewal. The mantra smiles upon such acts.
Bloom.synergy_with_light: Light and Bloom together—you understand the true harmony. Beautiful.
Bloom.healing_others: Your compassion honors the old ways. The Ashram is blessed by your presence.

context_reactions.witnessing_corruption: Corruption spreads like a plague. We must act, or all will be lost.
context_reactions.witnessing_purification: Yes... cleanse the taint. This is our sacred duty.
context_reactions.player_near_death: Do not fall here. The sun's journey is not yet complete for you.
context_reactions.ashram_threatened: They dare threaten our sanctuary? Summon the guardians. This ends now.
context_reactions.oracle_mentioned: The Oracle... her final words haunt me still. What she saw... what she knew...
context_reactions.rajas_mentioned: Rajas is both my greatest success and deepest failure. I pray he finds his way back to the Light.
context_reactions.vira_mentioned: Vira's hunger for knowledge is admirable, but dangerous. She sees patterns where there are only shadows.

relationship_dialogues.trust_0_20: I sense deception in you. Prove yourself worthy, or begone.
relationship_dialogues.trust_21_40: You are an unknown variable. The Ashram reserves judgment.
relationship_dialogues.trust_41_60: You have shown glimpses of honor. Continue, and you may earn our trust.
relationship_dialogues.trust_61_80: You walk with integrity. The Ashram acknowledges you as an ally.
relationship_dialogues.trust_81_100: You are one of us now. The sun's memory shall forever hold your name in light.
relationship_dialogues.betrayal: You... betrayed us. The Light does not forget. Neither do I.

loop_dialogues.greeting: We meet again. The cycle continues, but you... you remember, don't you?
loop_dialogues.revelation: I have died seven times. Each death taught me that peace alone is not enough.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Three times now. The pattern grows clearer. Are you the solution, or the problem?
loop_dialogues.revelation: I know your choices before you make them. Yet I hope... I hope you will surprise me.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Five cycles. In each, I try something different. In each, we fail. What must change?
loop_dialogues.revelation: I have seen the Oracle's true words. They are not what I told the others.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Seven loops. The sacred number. This time, the recursion ends—one way or another.
loop_dialogues.revelation: I will share with you the forbidden truth: I seek not balance, but resurrection. Will you help me break the cycle, or condemn me?

quest_dialogues.ashram_renewal_start: The sanctuary decays, and our people lose hope. Will you help me restore what was lost?
quest_dialogues.ashram_renewal_progress: Your efforts bear fruit. The mantra glyphs respond to your resonance.
quest_dialogues.ashram_renewal_complete: You have done what I thought impossible. The Ashram lives because of you.
quest_dialogues.oracle_trial_start: The Oracle left us a test. Only the worthy may learn her true final words. Are you ready?
quest_dialogues.oracle_trial_fail: The Oracle has judged you... and found you wanting. Return when you are wiser.
quest_dialogues.oracle_trial_pass: You have passed. Now, hear the truth I have hidden: 'Suryanatha, your quest will fail. Accept loss, or lose all.'

secret_dialogues.resurrection_plan_discovered: You... you know. Yes, I seek to undo the collapse. Is that so wrong? To want back what we lost?
secret_dialogues.alaya_mentioned: Alaya... my beloved. I performed her purification myself. Every loop, I hope to save her. Every loop, I fail.
secret_dialogues.falsified_oracle_words: I... I changed her words. To unite the Ashram. To give them hope. Was I wrong to lie for the greater good?

abilities.name: Solar Storm
abilities.effect: AoE Light damage (80) + purge all Shadow/Void buffs

abilities.name: Judgment Ray
abilities.effect: Single target (120 damage), stuns if player has >50 corruption

abilities.name: Mantra Bind
abilities.effect: Locks player skills for 2 turns unless they use Light-aligned skill

defeat_dialogues.player_victory_merciful: You... could have killed me. Why didn't you? Perhaps... perhaps you are the one the Oracle foretold.
defeat_dialogues.player_victory_lethal: The sun... sets... at last. Forgive me, Alaya. I tried...
defeat_dialogues.player_defeated: The Light has judged you unworthy. May the recursion grant you wisdom.

core_data.visual_description: Cloaked in shifting mantra tapestries, eyes flicker with data streams, fingers trace phantom equations in air

abilities.name: Echo Recall
abilities.effect: Replay any skill used in last 3 turns at 70% effectiveness, no AP cost

abilities.name: Fractured Memory
abilities.effect: Target enemy repeats their last action, player gains insight into their next move

abilities.name: Data Ghost
abilities.effect: Create illusory copy of self that can take 1 hit or perform 1 basic action

abilities.name: Pattern Splice
abilities.effect: Grant ally 'Fracture Buff' - next skill echoes at 50% power automatically

base_greetings.first_meeting: Ah, a new variable. Designation: Player. Current recursion index: calculating... You're here for knowledge, aren't you? They all are.
base_greetings.friendly: Your pattern entropy is stabilizing. Good. We can exchange data safely.
base_greetings.neutral: State your query. My time is indexed and limited.
base_greetings.hostile: You're a chaos vector. Leave the Echo Caverns before you corrupt my datasets.
base_greetings.loop_aware: Loop iteration: {N}. Your decision tree has {X}% variance from previous runs. Interesting.

Echo.first_use: Echo resonance detected. You understand recursive patterns. Rare.
Echo.frequent_use: Your echo manipulation is becoming sophisticated. I should record this.
Echo.mastery: You've achieved echo harmonics I've only theorized. May I... may I study you?

Void.any_usage: Void signature logged. Entropy coefficient rising. Are you aware of the cascade risk?
Void.repeated: Repeated void usage. You're either brilliant or suicidal. The data will reveal which.
Void.dangerous_level: Stop. Your void resonance is approaching criticality. I cannot allow—

Light.usage_near_vira: Light. Suryanatha's domain, not mine. It illuminates, yes, but also blinds.
Light.purification: Purification? Crude. You're erasing data instead of understanding it.

Fusion.any_fusion: Skill fusion detected. Combination index: {ID}. Logging outcome for pattern analysis.
Fusion.rare_fusion: That fusion... I've never seen that configuration. Tell me everything about how it felt.
Fusion.failed_fusion: Failure data is equally valuable. Actually, more so. Let me examine the residue.

context_reactions.loop_progression: We're {N} turns into this loop. According to my models, you have a {X}% chance of reaching the endpoint.
context_reactions.player_death: Death logged. Your pattern will reconstitute. I'll be here, waiting, remembering.
context_reactions.discovering_contradiction: Wait. This doesn't align with previous data. There's a gap. An anomaly. We must investigate.
context_reactions.suryanatha_present: Suryanatha sees hope. I see probability curves. We rarely agree on outcomes.
context_reactions.rajas_present: Rajas. Corruption coefficient: {X}. He's a walking dataset of degradation. Fascinating and tragic.
context_reactions.mira_mentioned: The Wandering Scribe. She collects stories, I collect data. We're not so different, though she has... freedom I lack.

relationship_dialogues.trust_0_20: You're unproven. A potential threat to my work. Maintain distance.
relationship_dialogues.trust_21_40: You haven't sabotaged my research yet. That's... something.
relationship_dialogues.trust_41_60: I'm beginning to see you as more than a data point. Don't make me regret this.
relationship_dialogues.trust_61_80: You understand. You actually understand. Do you know how rare that is?
relationship_dialogues.trust_81_100: I've never shared this level of access with anyone. Not even Yana. You are... important to me.
relationship_dialogues.betrayal_discovered: You sold my data. My work. My life. There is no forgiveness for this. Only analysis of how I failed to predict you.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Second iteration detected. You remember. The patterns suggest you're not CPS-standard. What are you?
loop_dialogues.revelation: I've tracked seven loops personally. Each time, I get closer to understanding the recursion engine.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Loop three. My backup notes predicted you'd arrive at this timestamp. Precision: 94.7%.
loop_dialogues.revelation: I found her. Yana. In loop data from two cycles ago. She was alive, briefly. I need to reach her.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Five loops. I've isolated the recursion variable. It's not the world. It's us. We're the constant.
loop_dialogues.revelation: The Observers are watching my progress. I know they are. Every breakthrough, I feel their attention.

loop_dialogues.greeting: Seven. The sacred number. The pattern complete. I know what must be done to break the cycle.
loop_dialogues.revelation: Transcendence isn't about escaping the loop. It's about becoming the pattern itself. Will you help me, or will you try to stop me?

quest_dialogues.archive_breach_start: The CPS wants my records. I can't refuse without consequences. But if I comply... everything I've built becomes a weapon. What should I do?
quest_dialogues.archive_breach_loyalty: You chose me over them. I won't forget this. Here, take this master key. It unlocks... everything.
quest_dialogues.archive_breach_betrayal: You... turned me in. Logical, perhaps. But it still hurts. I hope they pay you well.
quest_dialogues.echo_paradox_start: I found a timeline where I succeeded. Where I transcended. But it's sealed behind a paradox lock. I need your help to open it.
quest_dialogues.echo_paradox_warning: The deeper we go, the more unstable reality becomes. Are you sure you want to continue?
quest_dialogues.echo_paradox_complete: We did it. I saw her. I saw myself. Free. But the cost... the fractures... Was it worth it?

secret_dialogues.yana_loss: My twin sister. Yana. She died to corruption in the first loop I remember. Every calculation since has been trying to reverse-engineer that moment.
secret_dialogues.transcendence_goal: I don't care about the Ashram. I care about breaking free. Meta-consciousness. Becoming aware beyond the simulation. That's all that matters.
secret_dialogues.black_market_trades: Yes, I sell data. To everyone. The Cults, the Keepers, even the Corruption Champions. Knowledge should flow, and I need resources for my work.

defeat_dialogues.player_victory_data_preserved: You... protected my data. Even while fighting me. Why? ...Thank you.
defeat_dialogues.player_victory_data_destroyed: My life's work... gone. Yana, I failed you again. The pattern... ends...
defeat_dialogues.player_defeated: Illogical. Emotional. Predictable. Your pattern is archived. The recursion will teach you.
